name: casp16_server_attack_msa_model_diversity_v1
parent_benchmark_policy: default parent is casp16_server_protein_v2_aliasfix with the P17/P25 repaired 79-job scoreable input; switch benchmark only if post-P25 readout selects versioned refmap first
source_recipe: MULTICOM4-style diverse MSA generation, extensive sampling, and ensemble quality assessment
GuijunLab/QA4-style enhanced MSA generation and model quality assessment
CASP16 complex-assessment finding that extensive sampling helped but model ranking stayed a bottleneck

input_policy.scoreable_subset_policy: Use the same repaired 79-job scoreable input as P17/P25 unless the complete post-P25 readout selects versioned refmap first; skipped no-reference targets remain fixed-set zeros.
input_policy.variant_rule: Every variant must be generated by a target-agnostic rule before prediction. Do not choose variants per target from scores.

variant_classes.name: control_full_msa_template
variant_classes.description: Current repaired Protenix full-MSA/template scoreable input stack; P17 supplies seeds101-105 and active P25 adds seeds106-125.

variant_classes.name: p27b_defaultparams_model_config
variant_classes.description: Executable repaired-input Protenix model/config variant: six target-disjoint shards, seeds101-105, real MSA/template, complete MSA preflight, only use_default_params differs.

variant_classes.name: p25_consensus_selector_replay
variant_classes.description: No-GPU selector replay registered by scripts/finish_p25_scoreable_input_repair.sh after P25 merge; tests diversity_confidence_consensus_v1 on the same 25-candidate pool.

variant_classes.name: alternative_msa_cutoff_or_database
variant_classes.description: Different MSA generation tool, database, coverage, or e-value policy applied globally, not per target. The local run-spec CLI now records Protenix --msa_server_mode explicitly, so a production ColabFold/MMseqs MSA variant can be audited separately from the default Protenix MSA service.

variant_classes.name: domain_aware_msa_variant
variant_classes.description: Domain-aware MSA construction for long or multidomain protein targets using benchmark metadata and public sequence annotations only.

variant_classes.name: second_af3_like_backend_or_model_variant
variant_classes.description: OpenDDE/Protenix/AF3-like variant if it can run production MSA/template settings under the same benchmark and selection rules.

forbidden_toy_settings: manual per-target parameter changes after seeing scores

prepared_children.name: p27b_defaultparams_model_config
prepared_children.budget: 6 target shards * 5 seeds, real MSA/template, repaired 79-job input

prepared_children.name: p28a_colabfold_msa_server_mode_probe
prepared_children.budget: same repaired 79-job scoreable input, real MSA/template, seeds101-105, global msa_server_mode=colabfold or equivalent precomputed ColabFold/MMseqs A3M paths
prepared_children.preflight: must prove every generated or reused MSA path exists before GPU launch

allowed_selection_signals: prediction confidence JSON generated by the same run
interface confidence when emitted by the predictor
geometry and clash diagnostics computed from predictions only
forbidden_selection_signals: leaderboard rows used as a per-target oracle
manual per-target intervention after seeing scores
launch_gate: Merge, score, and refresh leaderboard for complete P25 first; the P25 wrapper also registers the no-GPU consensus replay and writes post-P25 readout JSON.
Do not launch if P25 has many missing predictions, metric failures, or exact-artifact lookup failures after completion; fix the pipeline first.
Do not launch if P25 is mainly reference-limited; use versioned refmap recovery or the v4/P15 row instead.
Launch prepared P27b before building true MSA variants if complete P25 is flat but valid; P27b is the cheapest model/config diversity probe.
Before any ColabFold/MMseqs MSA variant launch, prove the Protenix runtime imports from Protenix-Insta rather than OpenDDE and records msa_server_mode=colabfold in every run_spec.json.
Only create executable run specs after all variant inputs exist, all MSA policies are explicit, and a preflight report proves no stale cache paths.
Score only after all 20 declared candidates exist for every predicted target, or mark the row partial/unranked.

execution_policy.merge_policy: final merged run must declare candidate_count=20 and include every variant/seed candidate before ranked scoring
execution_policy.gpu_budget_policy: record expected GPU-hours before launch and actual wall time after each shard

budget_note: This design exists to reproduce the public CASP16 lesson that stronger systems used input/model diversity plus QA, not a toy no-MSA setting and not hidden target-specific tuning. It is intentionally gated behind complete P25 because P25 determines whether the next compute should be analysis, P27b model/config diversity, D6a input repair, O5b antibody/Fv, versioned refmap, or a true MSA/model-diversity budget.
